# Name prefixes the environment-name rule scans the driver binary for, besides ^PG[A-Z_]+$. A string
# found under one of them must be in refused-environment.txt, known-environment.txt or, if it is not
# a variable, ignored-strings.txt. One prefix per line.
SSL
AWS_
KRB5
CURL
ODBC
AMAZON
HTTP_PROXY
HTTPS_PROXY
ALL_PROXY
NO_PROXY
http_proxy
https_proxy
all_proxy
no_proxy
